title: PCETbase: an open database of solution-phase PCET thermochemistry (BDFE, E°, pKa)
description: Open community database of solution-phase proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) thermochemistry: bond dissociation free energies (BDFE), standard potentials (E°) and pKa values on self-consistent scales, with per-entry provenance, reference-electrode conversions and a recomputable recommendation policy. Interactive explorer: https://carsten-streb.github.io/pcetbase/. Core data extracted from Agarwal et al., Chem. Rev. 2022, 122, 1-49 (doi:10.1021/acs.chemrev.1c00521), extended with primary-literature polyoxometalate entries. Please also cite the primary source of each value you use.
notes: Funding: This database is developed as part of the Collaborative Research Center SFB 1633 "PCET" (https://uni-goettingen.de/de/683468.html), funded by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft DFG (grant no: 536858973).
